drhp.business: Sreeleathers Limited sells leather and non-leather footwear (gents', ladies' and children's) and accessories (belts, wallets, bags, briefcases and travel) through a network of exclusive stores and franchise dealers. The company sources hyper-locally, pairing Kolkata-rooted products with goods from Agra, Mumbai and Delhi close to where each store operates, and holds one price on a style through the year rather than running discount sales.
drhp.end_markets: India — 8 states, value/mass-market footwear segment (priced up to Rs. 2,500 a pair)
drhp.expansion: The Company is entering a deliberate period of capital expenditure with three parts: (1) quadrupling warehousing capacity so new stores are stocked from day one and existing ones never wait; (2) owning stores outright (rather than franchising) in regions entered for the first time; and (3) pushing further into northern and central India, building on traction already shown in Rajasthan and Haryana. strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Value-focused positioning: the Company rejects the industry's premiumisation thesis and remains committed to its value-focused strategy, believing value is a cultural instinct in how much of India shops, not just a function of income.
